summary: Evans introduced a House resolution declaring the slogan 'Free Palestine' an official antisemitic slogan, citing a Molotov cocktail attack in Boulder.
quote: Republican Representative Gabe Evans from Colorado introduced the resolution in the wake of the attack on a gathering for Israeli hostages in Boulder this week.

summary: FEC filings show Evans received $84,972 from pro-Israel PACs total, including $68,150 from AIPAC PAC/United Democracy Project and $14,323 from RJC PAC.
quote: Gabe Evans has received $84,972 from pro-Israel PACs in FEC filings — $68,150 of it from AIPAC PAC and its super PAC, United Democracy Project

summary: In the 2026 cycle Evans received $76,520 from pro-Israel PACs (AIPAC $68K, RJC $6K); $100K was spent against him by BOLD America.
quote: Gabe Evans has received $76,520 from pro-Israel PACs, had $100,000 spent against them in the 2026 cycle, chiefly from BOLD America

summary: On the 3rd anniversary of Oct 7, Evans posted that he 'stand[s] with Israel and Colorado's Jewish community' and called antisemitism out of place in the state.
quote: Today and every day, I stand with Israel and Colorado's Jewish community. We will never forget.
